$schema-note: Verbatim export of the SOLAR Foundations Figma variable collections, text styles and effect styles. Values in curly braces are aliases to another variable (Primitives collection unless a collection prefix is shown). Colors are sRGB hex; 'a' is alpha 0-1. Sizes are px. This file is the token source of truth for this repo until an automated Figma->JSON export replaces it.

source.capturedFrom: a private copy of the file at the same content version (Plugin API, read-only)

textStyles._format: name: [family, style, size px (Desktop mode), line-height px, letter-spacing]. Letter spacing is % of font size unless suffixed px. Sizes and line heights are bound to the Type collection and switch with the Desktop/Mobile mode.
textStyles._note: The 13 '.[utility]/...' styles are legacy utility styles used inside the Foundations documentation file itself; they are not part of the product type ramp.

effectStyles._format: name: list of drop-shadow layers {x, y, blur, spread, color variable, light-mode resolved rgba}. Colors are bound to the Color collection shadow/* variables and therefore change in Dark mode (see the 'color' section).
